mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversation_usage (tenant_id, workitem_id, conversation_id, turn_id, agent_id, executor_id, channel, provider, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, reasoning_tokens, credits, usage_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workitemId}, #{conversationId}, #{turnId}, #{agentId}, #{executorId}, #{channel}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{cacheReadTokens}, #{cacheWriteTokens}, #{reasoningTokens}, #{credits}, #{usageAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), workitem_id = VALUES(workitem_id), agent_id = COALESCE(VALUES(agent_id), agent_id), executor_id = COALESCE(VALUES(executor_id), executor_id), channel = VALUES(channel), provider = VALUES(provider), model = VALUES(model), input_tokens = VALUES(input_tokens), output_tokens = VALUES(output_tokens), cache_read_tokens = VALUES(cache_read_tokens), cache_write_tokens = VALUES(cache_write_tokens), reasoning_tokens = VALUES(reasoning_tokens), credits = VALUES(credits), usage_at = VALUES(usage_at), gmt_modified = NOW(3)
